question: Hi! What massages do you have and how much?

greeting.text: Hello, and thank you for your message. Our therapists come directly to you where you are staying.
greeting.translation: Halo, dan terima kasih atas pesan Anda. Terapis kami datang langsung ke tempat Anda menginap.

answer.text: Which massage would you like? You can see all our treatments and details on {website}.
answer.translation: Pijat mana yang Anda inginkan? Anda dapat melihat semua perawatan dan detail kami di {website}.

closing.text: I am here to answer all your questions and to make your booking easy.
closing.translation: Saya di sini untuk menjawab semua pertanyaan Anda dan membuat pemesanan Anda menjadi mudah.
